payload.title: Signed GitHub webhook ingestion and tenant repository reconciliation
payload.description:
## Objective
Maintain and verify the deployed GitHub webhook path that reconciles cloud-hosted tenant repositories and publishes the resulting Kanbus change signal.

## Existing context
The cloud stack already contains webhook ingress, Secrets Manager, SQS/DLQ, an EFS-backed Git sync worker, and IoT publishing. Historical records conflict: the cloud-backend epic reports the webhook sync validation as complete, while task tskl-eo2.5.4 still reports a signed webhook check blocked on secret permissions. Reconcile the existing deployment and validation artifacts first; do not rebuild components that are already working.

## Scope
- Verify GitHub signatures and bind each delivery to the correct tenant.
- Deduplicate/retry deliveries safely through SQS and the sync worker.
- Reconcile the tenant Git checkout on EFS and publish a change notification.
- Verify failure alarms, DLQ behavior, and an auditable recovery path.
- Keep the Kanbus Git checkout authoritative; webhooks only trigger reconciliation.

## Definition of done
- A signed GitHub test event is traced through ingress, queue, tenant sync, and the resulting Kanbus-visible event.
- Duplicate/retry behavior and tenant isolation are evidenced.
- The runbook records the test and the precise credentials/permissions required.
- If existing evidence already proves these criteria, close the remaining child task with references rather than repeating deployment work.

## Non-goal
This integration is not required for single-worker Issue Router dispatch. Pull-request, review, and CI-triggered router actions require separate scoped stories.
